items.text:
Claude Fable 5.2 and Mythos 5.2 arrive on AWS

• Anthropic released Claude Fable 5.2 and Mythos 5.2 on AWS, offering faster, cheaper, and higher-capability AI for technical and high-risk work.
• Gemini can automatically pull and send personal Drive or email content to human reviewers, even without explicit tags, in a probabilistic manner.
• Nvidia's shares fell more than 4% on Monday, the first trading day after its board announced an investigation into CEO Jensen Huang's relationship with Alice Huang, a former Megaspeed executive suspected of spying for China.

Google sends your Gmail and Drive files to human reviewers.

• When Connected Apps are on, Gemini automatically pulls Gmail, Docs, and Drive content during chat.
• The system may return a full unredacted excerpt or the entire document, and results vary each run.

Do this: Check your Connected Apps settings and disable them to keep your data private.
